Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Registered nurses, working in intensive care units (ICU) [OR]  or department of emergency (ED)
-  The frequency of headaches more than three times per month

right.raw_text: -  The type of headache is migraine  [OR] or frequent episodic tension-type headache, which is defined by the Headache Classification Committee of the International Headache Society

left.raw_text: If the symptoms of a headache cannot be defined, the investigator will refer the potential participant to a neurologist for further diagnosis

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Current user of other kinds of essential oils  [AND] (e
, the external application on skin, [OR]  sniffing), and do not willing to temporarily suspend for nine weeks

left.raw_text: -  Having sensitive responses to the essential oil
-  The type of headache was neither migraine nor frequent episodic tension-type headache after diagnosed by the neurologist
-  taking medicine for long-term (such as Aspirin, [OR]  anti-coagulant, [OR]  medication for mental disorders, [OR]  contraceptives, etc
